svg.title: Deployed architecture across two Google Cloud zones
svg.desc: Customers reach an nginx ingress in us-central1-a. It load-balances between backend-a in zone A and backend-b in zone B and retries the next backend on failure. Both Spring Boot backends query the Citus coordinator in zone A, which distributes queries to db-worker-1 in zone A and db-worker-2 in zone B. A monitoring node in zone A runs Prometheus, Loki and Grafana.
